context.notes: Candidate-only install from the isolated build tree. The trial temporarily sets reader presentation values and restores all recorded values in finally; it neither clears user data nor changes model installation/cache files. It uses a genuine center tap to reveal the normal immersive reader chrome before asserting the image-information dialog. A passing test proves real enhanced application, but does not replace the separate non-writing page-3 checkpoint and continuous recording required for F2 visual acceptance.
